notes: 299/299 profile pages fetched over plain curl/urllib with a browser UA, 8 workers, 0.2s stagger. HTTP 200 on every one, 0 retries exhausted, 0 CAPTCHA/bot-wall hits, physicianData JSON successfully parsed on all 299. ROSTER MATCH: 7 of 84 roster rows matched, ALL 7 by exact NPI, 0 additional by name. Those 7 rows are 6 unique people (Derek Horstemeyer appears twice in the roster under the same NPI 1225018849). Name-matching was run and genuinely adds nothing: 17 roster last names collide with a GSH last name but every one of those has a different first name (roster Michelle Lee / Bryan Lee vs GSH Wendy Lee; roster Ryan Smith vs GSH Dean/Erin/Coy/Lincoln Smith; roster Albert Jackson vs GSH Tamiko Jackson; roster Robert O'Connor vs GSH William O'Connor; etc). 9 roster rows have no NPI at all. The 77 unmatched are overwhelmingly McLeod / Tidelands / Conway clinicians who simply are not on HCA's Grand Strand staff. TRAINING FIELD REALITY: this is the key negative finding. credentialsAndAccreditations carries only school/training rows (Medical School, Internship, Residency, Fellowship, Undergraduate, Graduate Degree). It NEVER carries a board certification row -- zero 'Board Certification' type entries across all 299 profiles. Board cert is a bare boolean on the specialty with no board named and no year. Of the 6 unique roster people matched, only 1 (Asfaw) has a Fellowship row, only 2 (Asfaw, Horstemeyer) have any training rows at all, 3 have boardCertified=true flags with no certifying body, and 0 of the 6 have a physicianBio -- every bio field is empty. So for the anesthesia cohort specifically this directory yields specialty label + practice group + phone, and essentially no training detail. CONTACT: zero real clinician email addresses exist anywhere in the 299 pages' server HTML. The only @-pattern present is the form placeholder 'xx@xxxx.xx' repeated on all 299 pages -- rejected, not reported as a finding. No mailto: link to any clinician. 95 distinct phone numbers across providerLocations, all practice/office lines rather than direct clinician lines. PEDS: 14 of 299 profiles mention a pediatric term anywhere. No LinkedIn was touched. No CAPTCHA was encountered or attempted.
